events.name: Houston Texans at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Bradley Roby returned one of Jameis Winston’s four interceptions for a touchdown and Ka’imi Fairburn snapped a fourth-quarter tie with his third field goal Saturday, lifting the Houston Texans to a 23-20 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and their...
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans win AFC South title with victory over Bucs

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady passed for 271 yards and a touchdown, sneaked for a third-down conversion to set up another score and threw a downfield block on another scoring drive to help the New England Patriots clinch their 11th AFC East title in a row by beating...
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots beat Bills 24-17, win 11th straight AFC East crown

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo converted a pair of conversions on third-and-16 to set up Robbie Gould's game-winning 33-yard field goal with no time left and the San Francisco 49ers eliminated the defending NFC champion Los Angeles Rams from playoff contention with...
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers eliminate Rams from playoff contention with 34-31 win

headlines.description: Devonta Freeman scored two touchdowns for the Atlanta Falcons before Jacksonville took a snap, and that was enough to beat the woeful Jaguars 24-12 Sunday in a match-up between teams long since eliminated from the NFL playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons score 2 early touchdowns, beat woeful Jaguars 24-12

headlines.description: The road to the Super Bowl in the AFC goes through Baltimore, where its MVP candidate will be waiting.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens win 11th straight, clinch top seed in AFC playoffs

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw for 279 yards and three touchdowns and Alvin Kamara ran for two TDs as the New Orleans Saints kept their chase of the NFC's No. 1 seed alive by rallying from a 14-point deficit to beat the Tennessee Titans 38-28 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints chasing NFC's top seed rally to beat Titans 38-28

headlines.description: Nyheim Hines pulled off a rare feat Sunday for the Indianapolis Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hines' long returns help send Colts past Carolina 38-6

headlines.description: A laugher became a thriller for the Miami Dolphins, and they needed overtime to beat the Cincinnati Bengals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins survive late collapse and beat Bengals in OT, 38-35

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Le'Veon Bell helped deal his former team's playoff hopes a big blow, leading the New York Jets to a 16-10 victory over the banged-up Pittsburgh Steelers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell, Jets damage Steelers' playoff hopes with 16-10 victory

headlines.description: Daniel Jones put together the best performance of his rookie season fresh off an ankle injury, throwing for 352 yards and five touchdown passes in the New York Giants' 41-35 overtime victory against the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones throws for 5 TDs, Giants beat Redskins in overtime

headlines.description: Drew Lock and Phillip Lindsay stood out even more than those hard-to-miss, all-orange uniforms worn by the Denver Broncos.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lock, Lindsay lead Broncos to 27-17 win over reeling Lions

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Derek Carr threw for 291 yards and a touchdown as the Oakland Raiders kept their playoff hopes alive with a 24-17 victory over the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raiders keep playoff hopes alive with victory over Chargers

headlines.description: Eagles cornerback Sidney Jones broke up Dak Prescott's fourth-down pass to wide receiver Michael Gallup in the end zone with 1:15 left in the game, and Philadelphia denied Dallas a division crown in a 17-9 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz, Eagles deny Dallas the NFC East title with 17-9 win

headlines.description: Kenyan Drake rushed for 166 yards and two touchdowns, Larry Fitzgerald added a 21-yard TD reception, and the Arizona Cardinals stymied Russell Wilson and the injury-depleted Seattle Seahawks in a 27-13 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals roll past playoff-bound Seahawks in 27-13 victory

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for two touchdowns and ran for another score, and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Chicago Bears 26-3 Sunday night to stay in contention for a first-round playoff bye.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes throws 2 TDs, runs for 1 as Chiefs beat Bears 26-3

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Aaron Jones rushed for 154 yards and two second-half touchdowns, Za'Darius Smith had five tackles for loss to lead a stifling performance Green Bay's defense, and the Packers became NFC North champions by beating the Minnesota Vikings 23-10 on Monday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers clinch NFC North with 23-10 win over Vikings
